description: This Java source file defines a Spring Boot REST controller named SpringDocCompatController, which provides redirect endpoints for OpenAPI documentation URLs to ensure compatibility with different tools and environments. It redirects legacy paths like /openapi.json and /api-docs to the standard /v3/api-docs.

classes.name: SpringDocCompatController
classes.description: A REST controller providing URL redirection for OpenAPI documentation endpoints to ensure backward compatibility.

methods.name: openApiJson
methods.description: Handles GET requests to /openapi.json and redirects to the standard /v3/api-docs endpoint.

methods.name: apiDocs
methods.description: Handles GET requests to /api-docs and redirects to the standard /v3/api-docs endpoint.

methods.name: redirectToV3ApiDocs
methods.description: Constructs a redirect URL to /v3/api-docs, preserving scheme, host, and port from the incoming HttpServletRequest.
